name: Nirmalya Roy
title: Professor and Associate Chair of Information Systems
researchAreas: Multi-agent reinforcement learning for inference scheduling
fitReason: Strong CS-method overlap in efficient robot perception and cooperative edge AI. This is a systems/perception option rather than a direct manipulation-policy or socially interactive robot specialization. The current lab profile explicitly includes collaborative learning, agentic perception and human-machine teaming.

physicalEvidence.summary: COHORT (March 11, 2026) evaluates CLIP and Grounded-SAM pipelines on actual Husky, Jackal and Spot robots with ROS 2 and an edge laptop. Behavior cloning and offline advantage-weighted regression initialize an online MAPPO scheduler for local execution, auction bids and inference offloading. More than 20 hours of real traces include static and moving robots. The learned actions allocate computation; they do not establish learned navigation or manipulation. Reported joint throughput/deadline success remains partial, not a hard guarantee. The current RobSenCom project identifies Roy as PI and COHORT coauthors Mohammad Saeid Anwar and Gaurav Shinde as his students, establishing group attribution.

shortVisit.summary: No current external-master’s short-visit invitation was found on the current faculty or lab pages. The university’s summer REU listings are explicitly undergraduate programs and cannot establish a visiting master’s route.
